hook.convey: straight things around us differ only in where they stop: the pitch between two wickets stops at both ends, light from a star starts somewhere and never stops, a track drawn with arrows never stops either way → count the endpoints

use.hi: Cricket pitch ek wicket se shuru hoti hai aur doosre wicket par khatam hoti hai. Iske do endpoints hain, isliye iski lambai naap sakte hain, 22 gaz.
use.en: A cricket pitch starts at one wicket and ends at the other wicket. It has two endpoints, so its length can be measured: 22 yards.

use.hi: Space mein ek tara roshni chhodta hai. Roshni tare se shuru hoti hai aur ek disha mein bina ruke aage jaati rehti hai, uska koi aakhri siraa nahi hai.
use.en: In space a star sends out light. The light starts at the star and keeps going in one direction without stopping; it has no last end.

use.hi: Naqshe par train ki seedhi patri ke dono taraf arrows bane hon, toh matlab hai ki patri dono taraf bina ruke chalti rehti hai.
use.en: If a map shows a straight train track with arrows at both ends, it means the track goes on both ways without stopping.

explain.convey: point (bindu) = an exact position, no length, no size; line segment (rekhakhand) = straight path between 2 endpoints → it stops at both → fixed length → can be measured with a ruler

point.hi: Bindu yaani point sirf ek jagah batata hai, jaise kaagaz par pencil ki nok ka nishaan. Uski koi lambai nahi hoti. Line segment yaani rekhakhand ke 2 endpoints hote hain, wahin woh rukta hai, isliye uski lambai naap sakte hain.
point.en: A point only marks a position, like the mark of a pencil tip on paper. It has no length. A line segment has 2 endpoints where it stops, so its length can be measured.

prompt.hi: Blackboard ka neeche wala kinaara ek kone se doosre kone tak jaata hai, aur hum use ruler se naap sakte hain. Yeh bindu hai ya line segment?
prompt.en: The bottom edge of the blackboard goes from one corner to the other corner, and we can measure it with a ruler. Is it a point or a line segment?

why.hi: kinaara rekhakhand hai: uske 2 endpoints hain aur lambai hai, jabki bindu ki koi lambai nahi
why.en: the edge is a line segment: it has 2 endpoints and a length, while a point has no length

simpler.hi: Bindu sirf ek jagah hai, jaise pencil ki nok ka nishaan, uski lambai nahi hoti. Rekhakhand 2 endpoints par rukta hai, isliye use ruler se naap sakte hain.
simpler.en: A point is just a spot, like a pencil-tip mark, with no length. A piece that stops at 2 endpoints can be measured with a ruler.

explain.convey: line (rekha) = 0 endpoints, goes on forever in both directions; arrows at both ends show it continues; paper shows only a part of it → a line cannot be measured, and drawing it longer does not make a different line

point.hi: Rekhakhand ke 2 endpoints hote hain, par line yaani rekha ke 0, koi endpoint nahi. Line dono taraf hamesha chalti rehti hai, isliye drawing mein dono taraf arrows lagate hain. Kaagaz par hum uska sirf ek hissa banate hain, isliye line ki lambai naap nahi sakte.
point.en: A line segment has 2 endpoints, but a line has 0, no endpoint at all. A line goes on forever both ways, so a drawing puts arrows at both ends. On paper we draw only a part of it, so the length of a line cannot be measured.

prompt.hi: Copy par line MN ka jo hissa banaya, woh 5 cm ka hai, aur blackboard par 50 cm ka. Kya blackboard wali line MN zyada lambi line hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: The part of line MN drawn in a notebook is 5 cm, and the part drawn on the blackboard is 50 cm. Is the blackboard's line MN a longer line, yes or no?

why.hi: rekhakhand rukta hai, par line ke dono taraf arrows hain; 5 cm aur 50 cm sirf uske hisse hain
why.en: a line segment stops, but a line has arrows on both sides; 5 cm and 50 cm are only parts of it

simpler.hi: Rekhakhand do endpoints par rukta hai. Line ke dono taraf arrows hain, woh kabhi nahi rukti, isliye uski lambai naap nahi sakte.
simpler.en: Every line segment stops at two endpoints. A line has arrows on both sides and never stops, so its length cannot be measured.

explain.convey: ray (kiran) = exactly one endpoint where it starts, then forever in ONE direction; drawn with a dot at the start and an arrow on the other side; a line has arrows both ways and no dot

point.hi: Ray yaani kiran ek endpoint se shuru hoti hai, wahan shuru mein dot lagate hain. Phir woh sirf ek disha mein hamesha chalti rehti hai, isliye doosri taraf ek arrow hota hai. Line par koi dot nahi hota aur dono taraf arrows hote hain.
point.en: A ray starts at one endpoint, and we put a dot there at the start. Then it goes on forever in just one direction, so the other side has an arrow. A line has no dot and has arrows at both ends.

prompt.hi: Suraj ki roshni suraj se nikalti hai aur ek disha mein aage badhti jaati hai. Yeh line segment, line ya ray jaisi hai?
prompt.en: Sunlight comes out of the sun and keeps going in one direction. Is it like a line segment, a line or a ray?

why.hi: roshni suraj se shuru hokar sirf ek taraf jaati hai, dono taraf nahi
why.en: the light starts at the sun and goes one way, like a ray's single arrow, not a line's arrows on both sides

simpler.hi: Kiran ek endpoint se shuru hoti hai, wahan dot lagate hain. Phir woh sirf ek disha mein chalti rehti hai, isliye doosri taraf ek arrow hota hai.
simpler.en: It starts at one endpoint, marked with a dot. Then it goes on in just one direction, so the other end has an arrow.

problem.hi: Batao har ek bindu hai, line segment hai, line hai ya ray: (a) naqshe par do sadakon ke milne ki exact jagah P; (b) laser pointer ki roshni, jo pointer se shuru hokar bina ruke aage jaati hai; (c) darwaze ka kinaara, upar ke kone se neeche ke kone tak; (d) naqshe par seedhi railway track jiske dono taraf arrows hain, yaani woh dono taraf bina ruke chalti hai.
problem.en: Say whether each is a point, a line segment, a line or a ray: (a) the exact spot P where two roads cross on a map; (b) the beam of a laser pointer, which starts at the pointer and goes on without stopping; (c) the edge of a door from its top corner to its bottom corner; (d) a straight railway track on a map with arrows at both ends, meaning it goes on both ways without stopping.

givens.hi: P ek exact jagah hai, laser pointer se shuru hokar rukta nahi, darwaze ka kinaara upar ke kone se neeche ke kone tak hai, aur track ke dono taraf arrows hain
givens.en: P is an exact spot, the laser starts at the pointer and never stops, the door edge runs from the top corner to the bottom corner, and the track has arrows at both ends

find.hi: har ek ka naam: bindu, line segment, line ya ray
find.en: the name of each: point, line segment, line or ray

why.hi: usmein sirf ek jagah hai, koi lambai nahi
why.en: it is only a position, with no length

simpler.hi: P sirf ek jagah batata hai. Uski koi lambai nahi, isliye woh bindu hai.
simpler.en: P only marks a spot. It has no length, so it is a point.

do.hi: (b) Laser ki roshni ke endpoints gino
do.en: (b) Count the endpoints of the laser beam

steps.result: ek endpoint, toh yeh ray hai

why.hi: roshni pointer se shuru hoti hai aur ek hi disha mein chalti rehti hai
why.en: the light starts at the pointer and keeps going in one direction

simpler.hi: Laser ki roshni pointer se shuru hoti hai, yeh ek endpoint hai. Phir woh ek disha mein chalti rehti hai, isliye yeh ray hai.
simpler.en: The laser light starts at the pointer; that is one endpoint. Then it keeps going one way, so it is a ray.

do.hi: (c) Darwaze ke kinaare ke endpoints gino
do.en: (c) Count the endpoints of the door edge

steps.result: do endpoints, toh yeh line segment yaani rekhakhand hai

why.hi: kinaara upar ke kone se shuru hokar neeche ke kone par rukta hai, isliye uski lambai naap sakte hain
why.en: the edge starts at the top corner and stops at the bottom corner, so its length can be measured

simpler.hi: Darwaze ka kinaara upar ke kone se shuru hokar neeche ke kone par rukta hai. Do endpoints hain, isliye yeh rekhakhand hai.
simpler.en: The door edge starts at the top corner and stops at the bottom corner. It has two endpoints, so it is a line segment.

prompt.hi: (d) Railway track ke dono taraf arrows hain, yaani koi endpoint nahi. Yeh line segment, line ya ray hai?
prompt.en: (d) The railway track has arrows at both ends, so no endpoint. Is it a line segment, a line or a ray?

simpler.hi: Arrow ka matlab hai ki us taraf woh rukti nahi. Dono taraf arrows hain, toh socho kaunsi cheez dono taraf chalti rehti hai.
simpler.en: An arrow means it does not stop on that side. With arrows at both ends, think which one goes on both ways.

why.hi: track ke dono taraf arrows hain: ray jaisa ek endpoint nahi, rekhakhand jaise do endpoints bhi nahi
why.en: arrows at both ends: not one endpoint like a ray, nor two like a line segment, so no endpoint at all

answer.hi: (a) bindu, (b) ray, (c) line segment aur (d) line
answer.en: (a) point, (b) ray, (c) line segment and (d) line

why.hi: har ek ke endpoints alag hain: bindu ek jagah hai, ray ka ek endpoint, line segment ke do, line ka koi nahi
why.en: each differs in endpoints: a point is just a position, a ray has one, a line segment two, a line none

prompt.hi: Line AB ke dono taraf arrows hain aur kaagaz par uski drawing 7 cm ki hai. Kya line AB ki lambai 7 cm hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Line AB has arrows at both ends and its drawing on paper is 7 cm. Is the length of line AB 7 cm, yes or no?

why.hi: dono taraf arrows ka matlab line AB kahin nahi rukti, 7 cm sirf uski drawing hai
why.en: arrows at both ends mean line AB never stops; 7 cm is only its drawing

simpler.hi: Dono taraf arrows ka matlab line AB kahin nahi rukti. 7 cm sirf kaagaz par bani drawing ki lambai hai.
simpler.en: Arrows at both ends mean line AB never stops. 7 cm is only the length of the drawing on paper.

prompt.hi: Car ki headlight ki roshni headlight se shuru hoti hai aur aage badhti jaati hai. Yeh line segment, line ya ray jaisi hai?
prompt.en: The light of a car's headlight starts at the headlight and keeps going forward. Is it like a line segment, a line or a ray?

why.hi: roshni headlight se shuru hoti hai aur aage badhti jaati hai, rukti nahi, toh ek hi endpoint hai
why.en: the light starts at the headlight and keeps going forward without stopping, so it has just one endpoint

simpler.hi: Roshni headlight se shuru hoti hai, wahan endpoint hai. Phir woh ek hi disha mein aage jaati rehti hai, rukti nahi.
simpler.en: The light starts at the headlight; there is an endpoint there. Then it keeps going in one direction and does not stop.

ladder.why: first straight use: a marking with a dot at each end and no arrows → two endpoints → segment
a real edge (ruler) that stops at both ends → segment
a torch beam: one start, no end → ray
predict: the same line drawn 3 cm and 10 cm is still one line
explain why a route with arrows at both ends has no fixed length though its drawing is 8 cm

remediation.move: zoom-out: the drawn part of a line is a window onto something that keeps going past the paper's edge; a segment stops at its two endpoints, so only the segment has a length

say.hi: Line ke dono taraf ke arrows batate hain ki line kaagaz ke bahar bhi chalti rehti hai. Drawing chhoti ho ya lambi, woh usi line ka sirf ek hissa hai. Rekhakhand do endpoints par rukta hai, isliye sirf usi ko naap sakte hain.
say.en: The arrows at both ends of a line say it goes on beyond the paper. Whether the drawing is short or long, it is only a part of the same line. A line segment stops at two endpoints, so only it can be measured.

simpler.hi: Line ke arrows batate hain ki woh aage chalti rehti hai. Rekhakhand do endpoints par rukta hai, isliye sirf usi ko naap sakte hain.
simpler.en: A line's arrows say it goes on and on. A line segment stops at two endpoints, so only it can be measured.

prompt.hi: Ek hi line CD ki do drawings hain, 5 cm aur 9 cm ki. Kya 9 cm wali drawing mein line CD lambi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: The same line CD has two drawings, 5 cm and 9 cm. Is line CD longer in the 9 cm drawing, yes or no?

why.hi: 5 cm aur 9 cm, dono ek hi line CD ki drawings hain, aur line khud kahin nahi rukti
why.en: the 5 cm and 9 cm drawings are both of the same line CD, and the line itself never stops

simpler.hi: Jo kabhi nahi rukti, uski lambai naap nahi sakte. 5 cm aur 9 cm sirf do drawings ke hisse hain, line wahi hai.
simpler.en: Something that never stops cannot be measured. 5 cm and 9 cm are only two drawn parts; the line is the same.

remediation.move: torch beam: the torch is where the light starts (the one endpoint); ask where the light ends → no place can be named → so one dot, one arrow

say.hi: Torch ki roshni torch se shuru hoti hai, wahi ray ka endpoint hai. Aage roshni kahin nahi rukti, isliye us taraf koi endpoint nahi banta.
say.en: A torch's light begins at the torch; that is the ray's endpoint. Further on, the light never stops, so there is no endpoint on that side.

simpler.hi: Shuru wali jagah par endpoint hai. Jis taraf roshni chalti rehti hai, us taraf koi endpoint nahi.
simpler.en: At the starting place there is an endpoint. On the side where the light keeps going, there is none.

prompt.hi: Lighthouse ki roshni lighthouse se shuru hokar samundar ki taraf chalti rehti hai. Iske kitne endpoints hain?
prompt.en: A lighthouse's light starts at the lighthouse and keeps going out over the sea. How many endpoints does it have?

why.hi: roshni sirf lighthouse par shuru hoti hai aur samundar ki taraf chalti rehti hai, kahin rukti nahi, toh 1 endpoint
why.en: the light starts only at the lighthouse and keeps going over the sea without stopping, so it has 1 endpoint

simpler.hi: Roshni jahan se shuru hoti hai, wahan endpoint hota hai. Jis taraf woh rukti nahi, us taraf koi endpoint nahi hota.
simpler.en: Where the light starts, there is an endpoint. On the side where it never stops, there is no endpoint.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab in sabke naam letters se likhna seekhenge, jaise line segment AB aur ray AB, aur dekhenge ki ray ke naam mein pehla letter kyun itna zaroori hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we learn to name all of these with letters, like line segment AB and ray AB, and see why the first letter in a ray's name matters so much.

hook.convey: a path that starts somewhere, passes a point and goes on → its name must say where it starts: the start letter comes first

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara player point A se nikalta hai, B se guzarta hai aur seedha aage daudta rehta hai. Is raaste ke naam mein A pehle aayega, kyunki shuru wahin se hua.
use.en: In a video game your player leaves point A, passes B and keeps running straight on. A comes first in this path's name, because that is where it started.

use.hi: Ek rocket launch pad L se uthta hai, baadal C ke paas se guzarta hai aur upar space mein chalta jaata hai. Is raaste ka naam ray LC hai, L pehle, kyunki rocket wahin se chala.
use.en: A rocket lifts off from launch pad L, passes near cloud C and keeps going up into space. This path is named ray LC, L first, because the rocket started there.

explain.convey: a line segment is named by its two endpoints in either order: segment AB = segment BA; a line by any two points on it: line AB = line BA; for these two the order does not matter

point.hi: Ek line segment ke do endpoints A aur B hain, toh uska naam line segment AB ya BA likhte hain, dono sahi hain. Line ke liye uske upar ke koi do points lete hain, toh line AB aur line BA bhi ek hi line hai. Rekhakhand aur line mein kya pehle likho, isse farak nahi padta.
point.en: A line segment has two endpoints A and B, so we name it line segment AB or BA; both are right. For a line we take any two points on it, so line AB and line BA are also the same line. For a segment and a line, which letter comes first makes no difference.

prompt.hi: Ek line segment ke endpoints M aur N hain. Uska ek naam MN hai. Uska doosra naam kya hai?
prompt.en: A line segment has endpoints M and N. One name for it is MN. What is its other name?

why.hi: segment ke dono endpoints M aur N hain, toh ulta likha NM bhi wahi segment hai
why.en: the segment's two endpoints are M and N, so written the other way round, NM names the same segment

simpler.hi: Line segment AB ko ulta padhkar BA bhi likh sakte hain, dono sahi hain. Segment aur line mein letters ka kram badalne se kuch nahi badalta.
simpler.en: Line segment AB can also be written BA, read the other way; both are right. For a segment or a line, swapping the letters changes nothing.

explain.convey: a ray is named starting with its endpoint: ray AB starts at A and passes through B; ray BA starts at B and goes the other way → two different rays

mustSay.en: the first letter is the endpoint

point.hi: Ray ke naam mein pehla letter hamesha uska endpoint hota hai, wahin se ray shuru hoti hai. Ray AB, A se shuru hoti hai aur B se guzarkar aage jaati hai. Ray BA, B se shuru hoti hai aur ulti disha mein A ki taraf jaati hai. Isliye ray AB aur ray BA do alag rays hain.
point.en: In a ray's name the first letter is always its endpoint; the ray starts there. Ray AB starts at A and goes on through B. Ray BA starts at B and goes the opposite way, towards A. So ray AB and ray BA are two different rays.

prompt.hi: Ray QP kis point se shuru hoti hai, P ya Q?
prompt.en: Which point does ray QP start from, P or Q?

why.hi: ray QP ke naam ka pehla letter Q hai, aur ray wahin se shuru hoti hai
why.en: the first letter of ray QP is Q, and that is where the ray starts

simpler.hi: Ray ke naam ka pehla letter uska endpoint hai, wahin se ray shuru hoti hai. Ray AB, A se shuru hoti hai, aur ray BA, B se.
simpler.en: The first letter of a ray's name is its endpoint, where the ray starts. Ray AB starts at A, and ray BA starts at B.

explain.convey: a ray's name has two letters but the ray has only ONE endpoint: the second letter is a point it passes through, not an end

point.hi: Ray AB ke naam mein do letters hain, par uska sirf ek endpoint hai, A. Ray B se guzarti hai aur aage chalti rehti hai, B par rukti nahi. Matlab A endpoint hai aur B sirf raaste par ek point.
point.en: Ray AB's name has two letters, but it has only one endpoint, A. The ray passes through B and keeps going; it does not stop at B. So A is the endpoint and B is just a point on the way.

prompt.hi: Ray KL ke naam mein bhi do letters hain. Iske kitne endpoints hain?
prompt.en: Ray KL's name also has two letters. How many endpoints does it have?

why.hi: ray KL sirf K se shuru hoti hai, L raaste par ek point hai, wahan rukti nahi, toh 1 endpoint
why.en: ray KL starts only at K; it passes L without stopping there, so it has 1 endpoint

simpler.hi: Ray AB, A se shuru hoti hai aur B se guzarkar aage chalti rehti hai. B par woh rukti nahi, isliye B endpoint nahi hai.
simpler.en: Ray AB starts at A, passes through B and keeps going. It does not stop at B, so B is not an endpoint.

problem.hi: A, O aur B ek seedhi line par hain aur O beech mein hai. Un sab rays ke naam batao jo O se shuru hoti hain aur A ya B se guzarti hain.
problem.en: A, O and B lie on a straight line with O in the middle. Name all the rays that start at O and pass through A or B.

givens.hi: A, O aur B ek seedhi line par hain, O beech mein hai, aur har ray O se shuru hoti hai
givens.en: A, O and B are on one straight line, O is in the middle, and every ray starts at O

find.hi: O se shuru hone wali sab rays ke naam
find.en: the names of all the rays starting at O

do.hi: Ray ka naam uske endpoint se shuru karo
do.en: Begin a ray's name with its endpoint

steps.result: har naam O se shuru hoga

why.hi: dono rays O se nikalti hain, isliye O hi endpoint hai
why.en: both rays come out of O, so O is the endpoint

simpler.hi: Ray ka naam hamesha uske endpoint se shuru hota hai. Dono rays O se nikalti hain, toh har naam O se shuru hoga.
simpler.en: A ray's name always begins with its endpoint. Both rays come out of O, so every name begins with O.

do.hi: O se shuru karke A ki taraf jao
do.en: Start at O and go towards A

why.hi: yeh ray O se nikalti hai aur A se guzarti hai
why.en: this ray comes out of O and passes through A

simpler.hi: Yeh ray O se nikalti hai aur A se guzarti hai. Pehle O likho, phir A, toh ray OA bana.
simpler.en: This ray comes out of O and passes through A. Write O first, then A, giving ray OA.

prompt.hi: Ab O se shuru karke B ki taraf jao. Is ray ka naam kya hai?
prompt.en: Now start at O and go towards B. What is this ray's name?

simpler.hi: Naam endpoint O se shuru karo. Phir us point ka letter likho jisse ray guzarti hai.
simpler.en: Begin the name with the endpoint O. Then write the letter of the point the ray passes through.

why.hi: yeh ray O se shuru hokar B ki taraf jaati hai, isliye naam O se shuru hota hai: ray OB
why.en: this ray starts at O and goes towards B, so its name begins with O: ray OB

answer.hi: O se do alag rays banti hain, ray OA aur ray OB
answer.en: two different rays start at O: ray OA and ray OB

why.hi: dono O se shuru hoti hain par ulti dishaon mein jaati hain, isliye yeh ek ray nahi, do rays hain
why.en: both start at O but go in opposite directions, so they are not one ray but two

prompt.hi: Game map par ray ST, S se shuru hoti hai aur T se guzarti hai. Ray TS kis point se shuru hogi, S ya T?
prompt.en: On a game map, ray ST starts at S and passes through T. Which point does ray TS start from, S or T?

why.hi: ray TS ka naam T se shuru hota hai, toh woh T se chalkar S ki taraf jaati hai
why.en: ray TS's name begins with T, so it starts at T and goes towards S

simpler.hi: Naam ka pehla letter hi ray ka endpoint hota hai. Ray TS ka pehla letter dekho.
simpler.en: The first letter of the name is the ray's endpoint. Look at the first letter of ray TS.

prompt.hi: Ek ray point G se shuru hoti hai aur H se guzarti hai. Is ray ke kitne endpoints hain?
prompt.en: A ray starts at point G and passes through H. How many endpoints does this ray have?

why.hi: ray sirf G par shuru hoti hai, H se guzarti hai aur aage chalti rehti hai, toh 1 endpoint
why.en: the ray starts only at G and passes through H, and it keeps going, so it has 1 endpoint

simpler.hi: Ray G se shuru hoti hai, wahan endpoint hai. H par woh rukti nahi, aage chalti rehti hai.
simpler.en: The ray starts at G; there is an endpoint there. It does not stop at H; it keeps going.

prompt.hi: Kya ray MN aur ray NM ek hi ray hain, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Are ray MN and ray NM the same ray, yes or no?

why.hi: ray MN, M se N ki taraf jaati hai, aur ray NM, N se M ki taraf, ulti disha mein
why.en: ray MN goes from M towards N, and ray NM from N towards M, the opposite way

simpler.hi: Ray MN, M se shuru hokar N ki taraf jaati hai. Ray NM, N se shuru hoti hai aur ulti taraf jaati hai.
simpler.en: Ray MN starts at M and goes towards N. Ray NM starts at N and goes the opposite way.

ladder.why: first straight use: a ray from P through Q → name it with the start first
read a name back: ray PQ starts at P
name → drawing: dot at M, arrow past N
error-spot: ray AB and ray BA called the same ray
ray BA on a number line: from 5 through 2 → towards smaller numbers

remediation.move: two torches on one line: torch at A shining through B = ray AB, torch at B shining through A = ray BA; the light covers different parts; a ray is named by where its torch stands

say.hi: Socho A par ek torch hai jo B ki taraf chamakti hai: ray AB. B par doosri torch A ki taraf chamakti hai: ray BA. Dono ki roshni alag disha mein jaati hai, aur naam ka pehla letter batata hai ki torch kahan hai.
say.en: Picture a torch at A shining towards B; that is ray AB. A second torch at B shines towards A; that is ray BA. The two lights go in different directions, and the first letter of the name tells where the torch is.

simpler.hi: A par torch B ki taraf chamke toh ray AB. B par torch A ki taraf chamke toh ray BA. Pehla letter batata hai torch kahan hai.
simpler.en: A torch at A shining to B is ray AB. A torch at B shining to A is ray BA. The first letter tells where the torch is.

prompt.hi: Ray DE mein torch kis point par hogi, D ya E?
prompt.en: In ray DE, at which point is the torch, D or E?

why.hi: ray DE ka pehla letter D hai, toh roshni D se E ki taraf chalti hai
why.en: ray DE's first letter is D, so the light goes from D towards E

simpler.hi: Jis point se ray shuru hoti hai, wahi naam mein pehle aata hai. Torch wahin hoti hai jahan se roshni nikalti hai.
simpler.en: The point where a ray starts comes first in its name. The torch is where the light comes out.

remediation.move: the second letter is a point on the way, not an end: the light passes B and keeps going, so A is its only endpoint

say.hi: Ray AB mein A endpoint hai, matlab roshni wahin se shuru hoti hai. B sirf raaste par ek point hai: roshni B se guzarti hai, wahan rukti nahi, aage chalti rehti hai.
say.en: In ray AB, A is the endpoint, meaning the light starts there. B is just a point on the way: the light passes through B, does not stop there, and keeps going.

simpler.hi: Ray AB mein roshni A se shuru hoti hai. B raaste ka ek point hai, roshni wahan rukti nahi.
simpler.en: In ray AB the light starts at A. B is just a point on the way; the light does not stop there.

prompt.hi: Game mein laser U se nikalta hai, V se guzarta hai aur aage chalta rehta hai. Is ray ke kitne endpoints hain?
prompt.en: In a game a laser comes out of U, passes through V and keeps going. How many endpoints does this ray have?

why.hi: laser sirf U se nikalta hai, V se guzarta hai par wahan rukta nahi, toh 1 endpoint
why.en: the laser comes out only at U and passes through V without stopping there, so it has 1 endpoint

simpler.hi: Laser U se nikalta hai, wahan endpoint hai. V par woh rukta nahi, aage chalta rehta hai.
simpler.en: The laser comes out of U; there is an endpoint there. It does not stop at V; it keeps going.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak humne do points ko jodkar ek line segment banaya. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki bahut saare points hon, jaise 4 points, toh unhe jodne se kitne line segments bante hain.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we joined two points to make one line segment. In the next part we will see how many line segments we get by joining many points, like 4 points.

hook.convey: places joined in pairs by straight paths (bus stops by roads, players by passes) → every pair gets one segment, not only the ones round the outside

use.hi: Ek shehar mein kuch bus stop hain, aur har do bus stop ke beech ek seedhi sadak banani hai. Har sadak ek line segment hai, aur uske do endpoints do bus stop hain.
use.en: A town has some bus stops, and a straight road is to be built between every two bus stops. Each road is a line segment, and its two endpoints are two bus stops.

use.hi: Football practice mein do players ke beech ka seedha pass ek line segment jaisa hai. Har jodi ke beech ek pass ka raasta hota hai, chahe woh players kinaare par hon ya aamne-saamne.
use.en: In football practice a straight pass between two players is like a line segment. Every pair of players has one passing path, whether they stand along the edge or opposite each other.

explain.convey: 4 points, no three on one straight line → every pair of points gives one segment; the sides round the outside are only some of the pairs; the opposite corners are pairs too and their segments go across the middle

point.hi: Yeh 4 points hain, aur inmein se koi teen ek seedhi line par nahi hain. Har do points ki ek jodi se ek line segment banta hai. Kinaare wale segments toh dikhte hain, par aamne-saamne ke kone bhi ek jodi hain, aur unka segment beech se jaata hai.
point.en: These are 4 points, and no three of them are on one straight line. Every two points make a pair, and each pair gives one line segment. The segments along the edge are easy to see, but opposite corners are also a pair, and their segment goes across the middle.

prompt.hi: Toh in 4 points ki har jodi ko jodo, toh kul kitne line segments bante hain?
prompt.en: So if you join every pair of these 4 points, how many line segments are there in all?

why.hi: 4 kinaare wale segments aur aamne-saamne ke konon ke 2, kul 4 + 2 = 6
why.en: 4 along the edges and 2 between opposite corners, 4 + 2 = 6 in all

simpler.hi: Har do points ki jodi se ek rekhakhand banta hai. Kinaare wale segments ke saath, aamne-saamne ke konon ke beech wale segments bhi gino.
simpler.en: Every pair of points makes one line segment. Along with the edge segments, also count the ones between opposite corners.

explain.convey: organised list with 5 points A-E: from A 4 new pairs, from B 3 new (BA is AB, already listed), from C 2, from D 1, from E 0 → add the new pairs, each pair once

mustSay.en: BA is the same as AB

point.hi: Ab 5 points A, B, C, D aur E hain. A se 4 nayi jodi banti hain: AB, AC, AD, AE. B se sirf 3 nayi jodi, BC, BD, BE, kyunki BA toh AB hi hai. C se 2 nayi jodi, D se 1 nayi jodi, aur E se 0, kyunki uski saari jodiyan pehle aa chuki hain.
point.en: Now there are 5 points A, B, C, D and E. A gives 4 new pairs: AB, AC, AD, AE. B gives only 3 new pairs, BC, BD, BE, because BA is the same as AB. C gives 2 new pairs, D gives 1 new pair, and E gives 0, because all its pairs are already listed.

prompt.hi: Toh in 5 points ko har jodi mein jodne se kul kitne line segments bante hain?
prompt.en: So joining these 5 points in every pair, how many line segments are there in all?

why.hi: nayi jodiyan 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 0 = 10 hain
why.en: the new pairs add up to 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 0 = 10

simpler.hi: A se 4 nayi jodi, B se 3, C se 2, D se 1, aur E se 0. Har agle point par ek nayi jodi kam hoti hai, kyunki BA aur AB ek hi hain.
simpler.en: A gives 4 new pairs, B gives 3, C gives 2, D gives 1, and E gives 0. Each next point has one fewer new pair, since BA and AB are the same.

problem.hi: Naqshe par 6 bus stops A, B, C, D, E aur F hain, aur inmein se koi teen ek seedhi line par nahi. Har do bus stops ko ek seedhi taar se joda jaata hai. Kul kitni taarein, yaani line segments, banengi?
problem.en: A map shows 6 bus stops A, B, C, D, E and F, and no three of them are on one straight line. Every two bus stops are joined by one straight wire. How many wires, that is line segments, are drawn in all?

givens.hi: 6 bus stops A, B, C, D, E aur F hain, koi teen ek seedhi line par nahi, aur har jodi ke beech ek taar hai
givens.en: there are 6 bus stops A, B, C, D, E and F, no three on one straight line, and one wire for every pair

do.hi: A se baaki sab bus stops tak taar gino
do.en: Count the wires from A to all the other bus stops

steps.result: A se 5 taarein: AB, AC, AD, AE, AF

why.hi: A ki jodi baaki paanchon bus stops ke saath banti hai
why.en: A pairs with each of the other five bus stops

simpler.hi: A ko baaki har bus stop se jodo: AB, AC, AD, AE, AF. Yeh 5 taarein hain.
simpler.en: Join A to every other bus stop: AB, AC, AD, AE, AF. That is 5 wires.

do.hi: B se sirf nayi taarein gino
do.en: From B count only the new wires

steps.result: B se 4 nayi: BC, BD, BE, BF

why.hi: BA toh AB hi hai, woh pehle gin chuke hain
why.en: BA is the same as AB, which is already counted

simpler.hi: BA toh AB hi hai, woh pehle gin chuke hain. Isliye B se sirf 4 nayi taarein: BC, BD, BE, BF.
simpler.en: BA is the same as AB, already counted. So B gives only 4 new wires: BC, BD, BE, BF.

do.hi: Isi tarah C, D, E aur F se nayi taarein gino
do.en: In the same way count the new wires from C, D, E and F

steps.result: C se 3, D se 2, E se 1 aur F se 0

why.hi: har agle bus stop ke liye ek nayi jodi kam bachti hai
why.en: each next bus stop has one fewer new pair left

simpler.hi: Har agle bus stop par ek nayi taar kam bachti hai. Toh C se 3, D se 2, E se 1 aur F se 0.
simpler.en: Each next bus stop has one fewer new wire left. So C gives 3, D gives 2, E gives 1 and F gives 0.

prompt.hi: Ab saari nayi taarein jodo. 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 kitna hota hai?
prompt.en: Now add all the new wires. What is 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1?

simpler.hi: Ek-ek karke jodo: pehle 5 aur 4, phir usmein 3, phir 2, phir 1.
simpler.en: Add one at a time: first 5 and 4, then add 3, then 2, then 1.

why.hi: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15, har jodi ki ek taar
why.en: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15, one wire for each pair

answer.hi: 6 bus stops ko jodne ke liye 15 taarein yaani 15 line segments banenge
answer.en: 15 wires, that is 15 line segments, join the 6 bus stops

why.hi: har jodi ki ek hi taar hai, koi jodi do baar nahi gini, aur koi teen bus stops ek seedh mein nahi
why.en: each pair has exactly one wire, no pair was counted twice, and no three bus stops are on one straight line

prompt.hi: Ek square park ke 4 konon par 4 ped hain. Har do pedon ke beech ek seedhi rassi bandhni hai. Kul kitni rassiyan lagengi?
prompt.en: A square park has 4 trees at its 4 corners. A straight rope is tied between every two trees. How many ropes are needed in all?

why.hi: 4 kinaare ki rassiyan aur 2 aamne-saamne ke pedon ke beech, 4 + 2 = 6
why.en: 4 ropes along the sides and 2 between opposite trees, 4 + 2 = 6

simpler.hi: Pehle 4 kinaaron ki rassiyan gino. Phir aamne-saamne ke pedon ke beech wali rassiyan bhi jodo.
simpler.en: First count the ropes along the 4 sides. Then add the ropes between opposite trees too.

prompt.hi: Ek octagon ke 8 kone hain. Har do konon ko ek line segment se jodo. Kul kitne line segments bante hain?
prompt.en: An octagon has 8 corners. Join every two corners with a line segment. How many line segments are there in all?

why.hi: pehla kona 7 nayi jodiyan deta hai, phir 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, aur inka jod 28 hai
why.en: the first corner gives 7 new pairs, then 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, and these add to 28

simpler.hi: Pehle kone ko baaki saare konon se jodo. Har agle kone par ek nayi jodi kam bachti hai, aur aakhir mein saari jodiyan jod do.
simpler.en: Join the first corner to all the others. Each next corner has one fewer new pair left, and at the end add up all the pairs.

ladder.why: first straight use: 3 points not on one line → name and count the pairs
4 villages, every pair joined by a road → sides and the two across, 3 + 2 + 1
5 players on a kabaddi diagram → every pair once, no pair counted twice

remediation.move: child's sides-only count → 'is A joined to C' → list pairs from A, then only the new ones from B, then from C → sides plus the segments across the middle

say.hi: Sirf kinaare ginna kaafi nahi hai. Aamne-saamne ke kone bhi ek jodi hain, aur unka rekhakhand beech se jaata hai. Pehle ek kone ki saari jodiyan likho, phir agle kone ki sirf nayi.
say.en: Counting only the edges is not enough. Opposite corners are a pair too, and their segment goes across the middle. First list all the pairs of one corner, then only the new ones of the next.

simpler.hi: Kinaare ke saath beech wale rekhakhand bhi gino. Har kone se baaki har kone tak ek rekhakhand jaata hai.
simpler.en: Count the segments across the middle as well as the edges. A segment goes from each corner to every other corner.

prompt.hi: Chaukor ABCD ke 4 kinaare toh dikhte hain. Har do kone jodne par kinaaron ke alawa kitne rekhakhand aur bante hain?
prompt.en: The 4 edges of ABCD are easy to see. Joining every two corners, how many more segments are there besides the edges?

why.hi: A aur C, B aur D bhi jodiyan hain, toh 2 rekhakhand aur bante hain: AC aur BD
why.en: A and C, and B and D, are pairs too, so 2 more segments: AC and BD

simpler.hi: A ko C se jodo, phir B ko D se. Yeh dono beech se jaate hain, kinaare par nahi.
simpler.en: Join A to C, then B to D. Both go across the middle, not along an edge.
